copy.introText: Some journeys deserve a little extra care. Falak Rides helps you arrange private transport for airport arrivals, Umrah visits, and time spent in Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah.
copy.introText2: Travelling alone, with family, or as a group? Tell us your plans and we will help you discuss the vehicle, route, and pickup details before you set off.
copy.benefit1Text: A direct conversation with our team, from your first question to your pickup plan.
copy.benefit2Text: Request a sedan, family vehicle, or group transport to suit your itinerary.
copy.introImageAlt: Private vehicles with Makkah and Madinah landmarks
copy.servicesTitle: for Every Part of Your Journey
copy.servicesDescription: From airport arrivals to visits across the holy cities, find transport for the journey you have in mind.
copy.fleetNote: Vehicle photographs show preferences. Actual model, passenger capacity, luggage space, availability, and price are confirmed with your quote.
copy.stepsDescription: A few simple details bring your next journey together.
copy.step1Text: Tell us your pickup point, destination, and any stops along the way.
copy.step2Text: Choose your date and time, then add your passengers and luggage.
copy.step3Text: Review the details and let our team confirm your vehicle and complete fare.
copy.whyText: Your journey has its own pace. We help you plan the transport around it, from airport connections to hotel transfers and private Ziyarat itineraries.

services.title: Airport Transfers
services.heading: Airport Taxi Service in Saudi Arabia
services.intro: A smoother arrival starts with a ride arranged before you land. Plan your transfer between Jeddah or Madinah airport and your hotel with Falak Rides.

sections.title: Jeddah Airport Transfers
sections.text: Connect King Abdulaziz International Airport with your accommodation in Makkah, Madinah, or Jeddah. Share your flight number, arrival time, terminal, and luggage details so the team can agree on a meeting point.

sections.title: Madinah Airport Transfers
sections.text: Arrange your journey to or from Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport. Our team helps you coordinate the pickup time, exact hotel address, and vehicle requirements.
items: Flight and waiting arrangements agreed in advance

services.title: City-wise Services
services.heading: Private Taxi Services Across the Holy Cities
services.intro: From a local hotel pickup to a journey between the holy cities, plan private transportation that follows your itinerary.

sections.title: Makkah, Madinah & Jeddah
sections.text: Tell us your pickup point, destination, and preferred travel time. We help arrange local city rides and intercity transfers, with space for the people and luggage travelling with you.

sections.title: Your Schedule, Your Journey

faqs.question: How do I book an Umrah taxi?
faqs.answer: Choose Book Now, enter your route and travel details, and send your request. The team confirms the vehicle, pickup arrangements, and total fare directly.

faqs.question: Can I book an airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your airport, flight number, arrival date, and hotel address. Confirm the meeting point and included waiting time with our team.

faqs.question: Which vehicle should I choose?
faqs.answer: Tell us how many passengers and bags you have. Vehicle photos show preferences; the team confirms the actual vehicle and its capacity before booking.

faqs.question: Can I include Ziyarat in my journey?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add the places you would like to visit and your preferred date. The team will discuss the itinerary, access, duration, and quote.

faqs.question: How much will my ride cost?
faqs.answer: Published route fares, where available, appear in the booking flow. Other journeys and packages are quoted in SAR after the team reviews your itinerary.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel a booking?
faqs.answer: Contact the team with your booking reference. Ask about applicable change, cancellation, waiting, and refund terms before accepting your quote.
